criteria.description: Encoder-independent classification heads and explicit pooling operators cover pooled, spatial-token, and MIL inputs with capability failures instead of silent substitutions.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_11/test_heads_and_losses.py exercises linear, MLP, attention, multilabel, ordinal, MIL, CLS, masked-mean, GeM, top-k, empty-token rows, and pooled-only capability errors.

criteria.description: Mandatory BCE-with-logits and cross-entropy baselines plus configured focal, label-smoothing, asymmetric multilabel, ordinal, class-weight, and masked reductions are implemented.
criteria.evidence: Hand-computed BCE/CE values, optional-loss finite backward checks, and the Phase 11 isolated suite pass.

criteria.description: A shared segmentation output contract and minimal 2D/3D UNet/FPN decoders preserve deep supervision and native output semantics.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_11/test_segmentation.py verifies 2D/3D UNet and FPN shapes, deep supervision, promptable/transformer interfaces, and native output preservation.

criteria.description: Dice+CE/Dice+BCE defaults and explicit focal, Tversky, boundary, class-volume, deep-supervision, sample, and voxel masking paths remain finite for empty/full targets.
criteria.evidence: Segmentation loss tests, masked boundary smoke, deep-supervision backward, and 2D/3D task wrapper tests pass.

criteria.description: Language-conditioned segmentation encodes text separately, fuses it with spatial visual features, supports 2D/3D, and zeros missing queries without reshaping text into masks.
criteria.evidence: Language decoder gradient tests cover visual/text gradients and 2D/3D shapes; test_task_wrappers.py covers separate batch text embeddings and a missing query mask.

criteria.description: Retrieval projections normalize image/text representations, learn a bounded logit scale, filter same-patient negatives, and expose a distributed-negative protocol boundary.
criteria.evidence: Alignment tests verify L2 normalization, same-patient filtering, all-filtered failure, and RetrievalTask shared-output consumption.

criteria.description: 2D/3D box heads, normalized/physical spacing and affine conversion, L1, IoU, and GIoU-style losses are available with valid-mask broadcasting.
criteria.evidence: Box head/conversion tests plus task-wrapper localization and multi-box masked IoU smoke pass.

criteria.description: Structured findings use a versioned JSON schema, count parse/schema errors before scoring, and only retain invalid raw output through an access-controlled debug sink.
criteria.evidence: Structured validation tests assert valid/invalid counts, parse/schema split, no default raw retention, and rejection of an unauthorized debug sink.

criteria.description: Multitask composition supports fixed and scheduled positive finite weights, fixed task signatures, weighting extension points, per-task diagnostics, and true-count reduction.
criteria.evidence: Multitask backward/schedule tests and uneven true-count reduction tests pass; validator composes classification, segmentation, and alignment in one synthetic graph.

criteria.description: Phase 11 implementation remains adapter-independent and accelerator-neutral with CPU/CUDA finite forward/backward coverage.
criteria.evidence: Source imports only shared core contracts in task/head/decoder modules; CPU/CUDA mixed head/decoder/loss/projection backward smoke and CUDA 3D segmentation smoke passed.

criteria.description: TPU/XLA head and loss parity executes on the declared topology.
criteria.justification: torch_xla is not installed on the workstation; tensor-only implementations and no fabricated TPU result are reported.

criteria.description: A distributed process-group run verifies uneven-count reduction and backend wrapping.
criteria.justification: No DDP/FSDP/XLA distributed acceptance fixture is available in this workstation run; the backend boundary and true-count reduction helper are implemented and unit-tested.

criteria.description: Phase 11 acceptance integrates required modules, tests, smoke behavior, report schema, and non-unknown criteria.
criteria.evidence: python -m medfm.tools.validate_phase --phase 11 passes after the report artifacts are present; isolated Phase 11 suite has 21 passing tests.
